headline: Dyson ownership, global engineering network and premium product strategy
description: A source-backed profile of Dyson's multi-entity structure, Singapore global headquarters, UK engineering base, product portfolio and dated manufacturing network.
metaDescription: Dyson company profile: legal-entity scope, Singapore and UK headquarters, products, manufacturing network, channels and competitive strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Dyson. Corporate and manufacturing statements are limited to the entities, facilities and dates covered by the cited sources; they do not establish the origin of every Dyson model.

ownership.summary: Dyson's company-information page identifies Dyson Technology Limited as one company that operates its websites, apps and connected products with Dyson Limited; it does not identify that entity as the legal company for every Dyson operation. Companies House records Sir James Dyson as the sole active person with significant control of Dyson UK Group Limited, with 75% or more of its shares and voting rights and the right to appoint or remove directors. That filing proves control of Dyson UK Group Limited, not by itself ultimate control across every Dyson group entity. Dyson's April 2026 California disclosure separately names Dyson Holdings Pte. Limited as ultimate parent of the reporting U.S. entities. These are different operating, control and reporting scopes.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuum cleaners and floorcare
productPortfolio.positioning: The core consumer category, spanning cordless, upright, canister, wet-cleaning and robotic formats in selected markets.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Supports broad premium floorcare planning, with format availability checked by market.

productPortfolio.name: Hair care
productPortfolio.positioning: Premium dryers, stylers and straighteners built around airflow, heat control and motor technology.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds a distinct premium personal-care assortment built on Dyson's motor and airflow platform.

productPortfolio.name: Air treatment
productPortfolio.positioning: Purifiers, humidifiers, fans and heaters that extend the brand into indoor environmental appliances.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Extends Dyson assortment planning into indoor air and climate categories.

productPortfolio.name: Audio and wearable technology
productPortfolio.positioning: A newer category represented by headphones, adding personal electronics to Dyson's appliance portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Introduces a newer personal-electronics category that needs separate demand and service planning.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dyson's company history says production moved to Malaysia in 2003 to work near suppliers and contract manufacturers; that is a dated network statement, not proof that every current machine is assembled there.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the current assembly location for the exact model rather than inferring Malaysia origin.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dyson says its Singapore motor facility opened in 2012. The company separately reported that facilities in Singapore and the Philippines had produced 150 million Hyperdymium motors by 2023.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm whether the contracted model uses a motor from the named facilities.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The Philippines Technology Centre combines research, engineering and manufacturing capabilities, while Malmesbury and Hullavington remain important UK research, design and development locations.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Distinguish development responsibility from final assembly on model-specific documents.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Country of origin and final assembly can vary by model, batch and destination market, so a specific product's rating label and packaging remain the stronger model-level evidence.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Check the rating label and packaging for country of origin and final assembly.

marketsChannels.evidence: Dyson says it operates across 84 markets, supported by its own websites, demonstration stores and third-party retail channels.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization, local warranty and service coverage for the target market.

marketsChannels.evidence: Singapore's St James Power Station is the global headquarters for research, engineering, commercial, advanced-manufacturing and supply-chain teams.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the regional commercial and supply-chain counterparty for the purchase.

marketsChannels.evidence: Malmesbury is described by Dyson as its UK headquarters, keeping a substantial UK engineering base alongside the Singapore-led global structure.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm which Dyson entity carries the UK sales, warranty and service obligations.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Dyson's advantage is a premium global brand supported by proprietary motor and airflow engineering, a wide direct-to-consumer presence and expansion from floorcare into hair care, air treatment and audio. Its challenge is to convert that engineering investment into clearly differentiated products while fast-moving competitors narrow feature gaps and floorcare growth shifts toward wet cleaning and robotics.

developments.title: Dyson publishes its 2025 California supply-chain disclosure
developments.summary: The statement identifies Dyson Holdings Pte. Limited as the ultimate parent of the reporting U.S. entities and describes group supplier-audit and responsible-sourcing controls.

developments.title: Singapore and Philippines facilities pass 150 million motors
developments.summary: Dyson said its motor-manufacturing facilities in Singapore and the Philippines had produced 150 million Hyperdymium motors.

developments.title: St James Power Station opens as global headquarters
developments.summary: Dyson opened its Singapore global headquarters with 18 laboratories and teams spanning research, engineering, commercial, advanced manufacturing and supply chain.

developments.title: Hullavington research campus opens
developments.summary: Dyson's company history dates the opening of its Hullavington research, design and development campus in Wiltshire to 2018.
